t: Edison-style, amber-coated filament bulb offers a vintage look in any room. Controlled via existing Wi-Fi with the WiZ app or by voice. No need to install an expensive dimmer, dim via smartphone, WiZmote or voice. No additional gateway required, simply plug in and download the app. No need to worry if the lights were left on by mistake, control with smartphone from any location. Choose from a wide range of energising cool to soft warm whites, or simply select from one of the preset modes, such as Focus or Relax, to create the ideal ambience for differing activities.
b: Works with - Matter - Amazon Alexa - Google Home - iOS App - Android App
